ownerOrganisationId.description: Internal id of the organisation that owns this element. Omit it to use the organisation in the access token, which is what a caller acting for itself should do. Supplying a different organisation requires permission to act on behalf of that organisation.

startDate.description: The start date of the version.

endDate.description: The end date of the version (optional).

allOf.description:
Status of the supplement product. Defaults to VERSIONED.

- **DRAFT** - Under construction and not ready for operational use.
- **PROPOSED** - Complete but pending review and approval.
- **VERSIONED** - Finalized and frozen; a new version must be created for further modifications. Remains authoritative for its validity period even after expiry.
- **DEPRECATED** - Explicitly withdrawn and should not be used; indicates an active decision to retract, not a natural expiry.

purchaseWindowRef.description: NeTEx ID of a PurchaseWindow instance (Product Parameters API, /v3/parameters/purchase-windows). Available values are listed in the Product Parameters API.

usageValidityPeriodRef.description:
NeTEx ID of a UsageValidityPeriod instance (limitations/usage-validity-period).
Available values are listed in the Product Parameters API.

**Not yet implemented:** this endpoint currently accepts but does not persist or return this field.

entitlementRequiredRefs.description:
List of NeTEx IDs of EntitlementRequired instances (limitations/entitlement-required).
Available values are listed in the Product Parameters API.

**Not yet implemented:** this endpoint currently accepts but does not persist or return this field.

items.description: NeTEx ID of an EntitlementRequired instance.

validityParameters.description:
List of validity parameters. The specified parameter tells where the supplement product is valid. This can be lines, zones, stops etc.

**Not yet implemented:** this endpoint currently accepts but does not persist or return this field.

fareTableRefs.description:
References to the versioned FareTable instances that price this supplement product.

The priceable object owns this link (as in products-spring): supply the fare tables that
price it here on write. Prices themselves live on the fare table — create/update them via the
pricing/fare-table API, then reference the fare table here. On read, `SupplementProductResponse`
surfaces the resolved fare-table NeTEx ids.

ChargingMomentType.description:
Charging moment type.

Note: Currently, only `BEFORE_TRAVEL` is supported in Entur sales platform.

exchangeable.description: Whether the supplement product is exchangeable.

refundable.description: Whether the supplement product is refundable.

FareStructureType.description: The type of fare structure. This indicates the method by which the fare is calculated, e.g. flat fare, zonal fare, point-to-point fare, etc.

ref.description: NeTEx id of the FareTable that prices this supplement product.

version.description: NeTEx version id of the referenced FareTable.

FareTableRef.description:
A reference to a versioned FareTable that prices a supplement product. The priceable object
side authors this link (mirroring products-spring), so the fare table version is required to
pin the exact fare table the link resolves to.

GenericParameterAssignmentGroupingType.description: How multiple GPA parameters should be combined (AND/OR)

value.description: The localized string value for the specified lang.

SupplementProductType.description: The type of the supplement product. This can be used to determine which parameters are relevant for the product.

validityParameterRefs.description: List of references for the validity parameters

VatGrpupType.description: VAT group type. This is used to determine which VAT rate applies to a product. The VAT group type is determined by the product type and the country of sale. For example, in Norway, food products are subject to a reduced VAT rate of 15%, while other products are subject to the standard VAT rate of 25%. In this case, food products would be classified as FOOD_VAT, while other products would be classified as GENERAL_VAT.
